name: hide-and-hunt
description: HIDE & HUNT — jogo multiplayer 3D de Prop Hunt para navegador

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hh/server" "npm run dev -w @hh/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hh/shared && npm run build -w @hh/server && npm run build -w @hh/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hh/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hh/server && npm run typecheck -w @hh/client && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
